title: Understand Data Model Acceleration and tstats
objectives: Understand Data Model Acceleration and tstats
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has normalized authentication events and a native root Authentication.Authentication model with acceleration disabled. In Settings → Data models on sh01, review its JSON source and enable acceleration with earliest_time=-15m. Stage it and restart virtual sh01.

Rebuild the active model and inspect the coverage, input revision and three scanned source events. Search | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication and open Job Inspector. Expect count=3 from the stored snapshot. Compare source fallback versus summaries-only behavior and stale snapshots; no native .tsidx file or full model hierarchy is claimed.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
